title: knowledge(performance): grouped query (Count + ColumnFilter = HAVING) for distinct values and duplicates
summary: A new performance knowledge article teaches developers how to use query objects with grouped methods and column filters to detect duplicate values in a single SQL statement instead of looping with multiple queries.
key_points: Query objects with aggregate methods and HAVING filters replace loop-based duplicate detection
Reduces SQL statements from table row count to one statement
Complements existing guidance on grouped totals
Includes code examples and verification against base application usage
Added to performance review skill with filter-and-count loop detection
quote: A query object does it in one statement.
